notes.title: Anniversary Edition 1.7!
notes.content:
v1.7 7/29/21

*changes/fixes* 

First anniversary expansion patch!  Thank you for playing (and being interested in the development, if you're
	reading this far in!)

	- New island area: Oka Mahina!  A relatively isolated moon-shaped island where all the inhabitants
		have come together to live in peace.  Town has a potion shop and pub/inn
	- New repeatable quest in the island Pub
	- New stat buff item and consumable healing items
	- Enemy drop table edits
	- More bug fixes in hidden shopkeeper code
	- Added in a skill the Queen was supposed to have, adjustment to stats
	- Lore updates and messed around with adding color to the lore text in tomes
	- Oka Mahina banner added
	- Boosted Queen's crit rate

notes.title: Patch notes for 1.6v
notes.content:
v1.6v  2/10/21

Congrats!  You all made it to 2021!

[u]*changes/fixes*
[/u]
	- For some reason, a certain hidden shop was not acknowledging you at all until you became a "champion." This should be fixed now, so the store isn't useless for most of the game!
	- Hearts Day 2021 NPC added
	- Adjusted and improved upon Halloween dungeon code I re-purposed for Hearts day event! Nobody should get stuck in a dungeon corner this time!
	- Adjusted Kraken skills
	- Fixed snow background not showing up in some main map encounters where it should've been.
